rotationSign: CSS rotate(); positive = clockwise on screen

flap.howTo: Alternate #wing-near between +90 (up) and -40 (down) and #wing-far between +118 and -25, about 8-10 flaps per second. Tilt #body -10 and tuck both legs +35 in flight; all 0 = perched/sitting. Peck: #head +30 with #body +10.

parts.description: Far leg (darker); pivot at the hip (+ back, - forward). Tuck +35 when flying.
Near leg; pivot at the hip (+ back, - forward). Tuck +35 when flying.
Round body with peach belly; pivot at the hips over the legs. Contains both wings, the tail and the head (+ tips forward, - leans back; -10 for flight).
Far wing (darker), behind the body; nested in 'body', pivot at the shoulder (+ raises, - lowers).
Fan tail; nested in 'body', pivot at the root (+ flicks up, - tips down).
Head with beak and eye; nested in 'body', neck base hidden behind the body (+ dips to peck, - lifts).
Near wing over the body; nested in 'body', pivot at the shoulder (+ raises, - lowers).
